main_text.l: שְׁמַע, שְׁמָא, שְׁמַע Syr. & Chald. Auditus: auditio, rumor, fama, nuncium, sonus, sermo.
שְׁמוֹעָתָא Ch. Idem, 1. Sam. 2.24. Psal. 112.7. Plur. masc. שְׁמוּעִין Rumores, Cant. 5.10.
מִשְׁמַע Ch. Idem, Jesa. 11.3. Pl. constr. Syr. ܡܫܡܥ Ex auditu, ad Rom. 10.17. בְּמִשְׁמְעֵי בְרָךְ In auribus filii tui, Exo. 10.2. in Jon.
מִשְׁמַעְתָּא Ch. Auscultatio, obedietia, 1. Sam. 22.14. Syr. ܡܫܡܥܬܐ Idem, ad Rom. 15.18. & 16.25.
ܫܡܥܢܐ Syr. Auditor. Plural. ܫܡܥܝܢ Auditores, ad Rom. 2.13. Ch. נִשְׁמְעָא Vir auditor, auscultans, id est, testis auritus, Proverb. 21.28. Reg. red. Bene audiens.
ܫܡܝܥܐ Syr. Obediens. Plur. ܫܡܝܥܝܢ Obedientes. Fœm. ܫܡܝܥܬ, Jac. 3.17.
ܫܡܝܥܘܬܐ Syr. Obedientia, ad Roman. 5.19. ad Hebr. 5.9. 1. Pet. 1.22.
שְׁמִיר, שְׁמִירָא Chald. Adamas, lapis durissimus, Zach. 7.12. Jerem. 17.1.
שְׁמָרִין Ch. Fæces, Hebr. שְׁמָרִים, Jerem. 48.11.
שַׁמֵּשׁ Pahel Ch. & Syr. Servivit, coluit, ministravit: Item Ch. Concumbere, coire, congredi, Ithpahel אִשְׁתַּמַּשׁ Ministrari, Coli.
מְשַׁמְשָׁא Ch. & S. Minister, Diaconus, Pl. מְשַׁמְשִׁין Ministri. Fœm. מְשַׁמְשָׁא. Plur. מְשַׁמְשִׁין.

page.notes: Much of the Syriac and Hebrew vowel pointing and the Syriac letters are only approximately reproduced; the lower Syriac entries and the final line are doubtful. Show-through from the reverse page is present and was left out.
